name: The Last Move Writes What The Screen Shows (a hint on the last cell or with the pencil on, a resumed daily, a final Speedrun combo)
note: Written with the gate on 2026-10-18 (ChatGPT's review, CH18-01…04, Diary 143; the re-review CH18-R01, Diary 144). Each mutation puts one of the fixed bugs back as it was in 1.5.0 and earlier, or as the first fix left it.

mutations.name: the win reads the hint count from before this hint
mutations.why: CH18-01: setHintsUsedCount lands a render after the win is recorded, so the first hint on the last cell saved a best time, a ghost and a hint-free clear under a card that said 'not a record'.
mutations.expectFailure: a hint game saved as a record

mutations.name: a hint follows the pencil and goes in as a note
mutations.why: CH18-02: the hint is spent and the cell stays empty.

mutations.name: resuming a game forgets the day it is the daily of
mutations.why: CH18-03: the key cleared before the resume never comes back, so a resumed daily ends as a plain win.

mutations.name: the save stops carrying the daily's day
mutations.why: CH18-03, the other half: the resume reads the day from the save; a save without it is a game of no day.

mutations.name: the win takes the clock from before the last cell's combo bonus
mutations.why: CH18-04: 04:59 on the card, 300 s saved as the best.
mutations.expectFailure: Speedrun, last cell in a combo

mutations.name: the win keeps only the streak alive at the last cell
mutations.why: CH18-04 and the streak found with it: a 2-combo before a pause, or the last cell's own combo, never reached the stats or the combo achievements.

mutations.name: a resume forgets the game's best combo
mutations.why: CH18-R01 (ChatGPT's re-review of b39f1a2): the best was kept beside the clock and a resume reset it — a 5-combo before a trip home was saved as 1 and 'combo 5' was missed. It is restored from the save now.
mutations.expectFailure: the best was lost over the resume
